title_en: Whoever Dies Without an Imam Dies a Death of Ignorance - Episode 3
description_en: Whoever Dies Without an Imam Dies a Death of Ignorance - Episode 3, an episode of the Al-Utruha al-Mahdiyya program by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: An episode from the Al-Utruha al-Mahdiyya program exploring the hadith regarding dying without an Imam.
